description: Commentary-selected plays with observed relative gold outcomes (E15/E30/E60)

not_covered.voidgrubs: Passive structure-damage buff. The commentary names grubs only when they are taken (0 later mentions in the 10 MSI games and 2 pilot games), and there is no time-resolved structure data yet, so grubs are not linked.
not_covered.dragon: Elemental dragon buffs stack and act for the rest of the game, so they cannot be tied to particular plays.

display.horizons_rounding_note: E uses four HUD readings. Per-reading error is within half the display resolution, so the true E lies in the open interval (E - bound, E + bound) with bound = q(a) + q(a+h). The sign is resolved when |E| >= bound.

kills.window: game clock at the play's start - 10 s to its end + 10 s
